notes.title: BIG UPDATE – Major Gameplay Overhaul!
notes.notes:
Hello bar managers,

We’re thrilled to release the biggest update yet for Beach Bar Simulator, packed with new systems, features, and improvements that will transform your bar management experience!

What’s included in this update:

New cashier system – Customers now place their orders at the cashier before heading to their seats, bringing a more realistic flow to the gameplay.

New coffee machines & grinders – Expanded brewing possibilities with brand new equipment.

12 new coffee types – Beyond Doppio and Espresso, you can now serve a full menu of coffee varieties.

New cup sizes – In addition to the mini size, small, medium, and large cups are now available.

Syrups and milk options – Customize drinks with added flavors and dairy choices.

Updated customer reactions – Improved AI responses to match your service quality.

No more time limit – The old day timer has been replaced with a level system. You can play freely until you reach Level 4. After that, you’ll keep running your bar with the unlocked content.

Sleeping system – End your day by heading to your caravan to rest and prepare for the next shift.

This update marks a huge step forward in making Beach Bar Simulator more immersive and feature-rich. We can’t wait to hear your thoughts and feedback!

Thank you for supporting the game and helping shape its future development. Don’t forget to add it to your Steam wishlist and share your experience with the community!

notes.title: Control Update – More Intuitive Interactions!
notes.notes:
Hello bar managers,

We’ve just released a new update focused on improving how you interact with the environment in Beach Bar Simulator. This quality-of-life change simplifies the control scheme, making the gameplay smoother and more intuitive.
What’s included in this update:
Actions that previously required holding the R key or tapping E have been removed

All main interactions are now performed using a single left mouse click

This includes picking up items, interacting with stations, and serving customers

The goal is to reduce confusion and improve overall responsiveness

This update is based on feedback from the community and is part of our continued effort to refine the core experience ahead of the full release.

Thank you for playing and helping shape the development of Beach Bar Simulator.
Don’t forget to add the game to your Steam wishlist to stay informed about future updates.

notes.title: New Horizons Update – Sea & Sky Rework + Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello bar managers,

We're excited to release a new visual update that brings a fresh look and feel to Beach Bar Simulator. This patch focuses on improving the overall atmosphere, refining key visuals, and fixing bugs for a smoother gameplay experience.

What’s included in this update:

A completely reworked ocean shader with improved reflections, lighting, and wave detail

A brand new skybox that enhances the tropical setting with dynamic colors and depth

Multiple bug fixes and minor improvements to UI and scene polish

Better overall visual coherence and lighting balance across the play area

This update is part of our ongoing effort to enhance the game's core experience before full release. We're actively listening to your feedback and continuously improving based on it.

Thank you for playing and supporting the development. Don't forget to add Beach Bar Simulator to your wishlist on Steam to stay up to date.
